g.text: F2 | panels a-b from experiments_main22/E2/curve_E2.csv: one point per (stream, policy, k); intervals =
percentile bootstrap of the mean over independent streams, 1000 draws, seed 20261031; the same 24 streams are
present at every k in 0..8 (site-day, not event, is the unit). Panel c = 7 kW run curve_E2_summary.csv with the
engine's own bootstrap CIs. The five-percent tolerance is the design-matrix service standard, drawn identical in
